targets.title: Local scalar and noncharacteristic hypotheses
targets.verified_scope: Local scalar and noncharacteristic hypotheses. RF1 retains real quadratic principal symbol, arbitrary smooth complex lower coefficients, local sign normalization and dimension at least two.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Local smooth Hamilton flow and transverse base map
targets.verified_scope: Local smooth Hamilton flow and transverse base map. RF2--RF3 apply only the generic smooth-flow portion of U050, with all parameters and inverse flow; no global time or nondegenerate cotangent metric is imported.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Canonical one-form proof of normal coordinates
targets.proof_locator: Here is why the transported covector
targets.verified_scope: Canonical one-form proof of normal coordinates. RF4--RF5 prove the transported covector is dr, using Lie derivative dp/2 and p=1, and remove the mixed principal terms even when the full quadratic form is degenerate.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Full normalized differential expression
targets.proof_locator: Here \(R\) is a smooth real quadratic form
targets.verified_scope: Full normalized differential expression. The normal leading coefficient is exactly one; the remaining normal first-order multiplication and full tangential second-order operator are retained.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Elliptic hyperbolic and glancing regions
targets.verified_scope: Elliptic hyperbolic and glancing regions. RF6 distinguishes R0<0, R0>0 and R0=0 at nonzero tangential covectors without imposing a Lorentz signature.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Two distinct roots and short Hamilton germs
targets.verified_scope: Two distinct roots and short Hamilton germs. RF7--RF8 give normal velocities, tangential r-flows and their orientation difference, with both unparameterized germs above one hyperbolic boundary covector.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Invariant reflection and conormal rescaling
targets.proof_locator: The root interchange has an invariant formula.
targets.verified_scope: Invariant reflection and conormal rescaling. RF9 preserves p and tangential restriction, reverses q(xi,nu), is an involution and is unchanged under nonzero rescaling of nu.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Compression and the intrinsic distribution class
targets.proof_locator: In product coordinates, an interior covector
targets.verified_scope: Compression and the intrinsic distribution class. RF10--RF11 use r rho and nonzero tangential boundary covectors, with the actual N=A-prime domain and intrinsic normal derivatives.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Intrinsic jets versus differentiation of zero extension
targets.verified_scope: Intrinsic jets versus differentiation of zero extension. The supported-extension formula includes the boundary delta, whereas the equation and all jets below use intrinsic differentiation.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Tangential smoothing and collar upgrade
targets.proof_locator: Two consequences will be used repeatedly.
targets.verified_scope: Tangential smoothing and collar upgrade. RF12 follows from full N-domain tangential action, empty boundary wavefront, closed compact cospheres and A intersection A-prime smoothness.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Exact elliptic tangential tester
targets.proof_locator: Second, if a compact boundary cone
targets.verified_scope: Exact elliptic tangential tester. RF13 uses the complete two-sided tester criterion at the exact AN03-U034 version, not a trace-only criterion.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Uniform cone tests for smooth source data
targets.verified_scope: Uniform cone tests for smooth source data. A compact tangential cone avoiding the compressed source wavefront removes all its normal lifts; N excludes pure normal boundary covectors, yielding a smaller smooth collar.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Scalar elliptic Dirichlet boundary identity
targets.verified_scope: Full scalar elliptic identity RF15 from EW32, with the original lower terms and local coefficient completion.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Positive cone extension and full-symbol comparison
targets.verified_scope: Positive cone extension and full-symbol comparison. RF16 extends the real separated roots while preserving their gap and the full operator in the smaller cone; errors are tangentially smoothing on actual N jets.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Both ordered complete factorizations
targets.proof_locator: Section 7 of the higher-order Cauchy lesson
targets.verified_scope: Both ordered complete factorizations. RF17 applies the full m=2 recursive polynomial-division and parameter-aware Borel algorithm separately in both orders; the two plus and minus full operators need not coincide.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Two first-order equations with exact initial test
targets.proof_locator: There are proper tangential order-zero families
targets.verified_scope: Two first-order equations with exact initial test. RF18--RF20 solve all transport corrections from the prescribed full Q0 and subtract the initial smoothing defect, retaining commuting errors of every negative tangential order.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Paired intrinsic tested distributions
targets.verified_scope: Paired intrinsic tested distributions. RF21 defines the two differently ordered tested normal outputs, each in N under the exact programme action theorem.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Full forcing and commutator identities
targets.proof_locator: All derivatives and tangential actions preserve
targets.verified_scope: Full forcing and commutator identities. RF22 retains both factor defects and both first-order commutators with their signs; every error acts smoothly on the actual intrinsic jets.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Exact boundary comparison of the two outputs
targets.verified_scope: Exact boundary comparison of the two outputs. RF23 uses equality of the full initial operators, not equality of their principal symbols, to make the difference equal Q0(A-minus minus A-tilde-plus)b and hence smooth.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Transverse reflection equivalence
targets.verified_scope: Transverse reflection equivalence. RF24 declares smooth forcing and Dirichlet data at one hyperbolic boundary covector; compressed boundary regularity is equivalent to regularity on either adjacent germ.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Boundary regularity to both germs and onward
targets.verified_scope: Boundary regularity to both germs and onward. The exact boundary tester first removes all lifts in a small collar; the full general interior U034 theorem then continues regularity along each source-free connected interior piece.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Ordinary ellipticity and exclusion of pure normal directions
targets.proof_locator: Conversely suppose the plus germ is regular.
targets.verified_scope: Ordinary ellipticity and exclusion of pure normal directions. For L-plus v smooth, ordinary ellipticity confines WF(v) to its graph; N and closedness exclude pure normal directions near the boundary.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Regular interior slice without a false uniform slope assertion
targets.verified_scope: Regular interior slice without a false uniform slope assertion. All normal lifts are controlled on a compact subcollar strictly inside r>0, yielding a regular slice; no ordinary bound on rho/eta down to r=0 is asserted.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Backward smooth Cauchy solution and distributional uniqueness
targets.verified_scope: Backward smooth Cauchy solution and distributional uniqueness. The exact U031 Schwartz-adjoint argument equates v to its smooth backward solution from that slice in the distributional test topology.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Boundary comparison and forward second output
targets.verified_scope: Boundary comparison and forward second output. RF23 supplies smooth initial data for the second equation, whose smooth forward solution agrees with its N distribution by the same uniqueness proof; RF25 is a full collar assertion.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Recovery of both full tested normal outputs
targets.verified_scope: Recovery of both full tested normal outputs. RF26 uses proper parametrices for both tests on a common smaller cone; remainders act on actual N jets and are upgraded to smooth collar functions.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Elliptic root-gap recovery of the original distribution
targets.verified_scope: Elliptic root-gap recovery of the original distribution. RF27 subtracts the two full outputs, cancels the normal derivative and uses the nonzero order-one gap plus an order-minus-one parametrix to obtain the exact boundary tester for u.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Symmetric converse from the minus germ
targets.proof_locator: If the minus germ is regular
targets.verified_scope: Symmetric converse from the minus germ. Start with the other tested equation, solve backward, use the same full initial trace difference, solve the first equation forward and repeat full-gap recovery.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Transverse broken bicharacteristic
targets.verified_scope: Transverse broken bicharacteristic. RF28 requires continuous compression, oriented characteristic pieces, invariant reflected lifts and locally finite discrete reflection parameters; no interior accumulation or glancing contact is admitted.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Forcing and boundary source set
targets.verified_scope: Forcing and boundary source set. RF29 embeds WF(b) into the tangential boundary bundle and uses the entire compressed WF(f) as the source set.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Local constancy at interior and reflection parameters
targets.verified_scope: Local constancy at interior and reflection parameters. U034 Theorem5.1 retains arbitrary complex lower terms and radial/stationary cases; Section4 gives both directions at each reflection.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Connected broken-ray wavefront alternative
targets.proof_locator: The two disjoint sets are open
targets.verified_scope: Connected broken-ray wavefront alternative. RF30 proves the regular and singular parameter sets are both relatively open and uses connectedness, including noncompact connected subintervals.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Limits of the transverse theorem
targets.proof_locator: The conclusion concerns the whole compressed curve.
targets.verified_scope: Limits of the transverse theorem. The argument closes transverse propagation and the scalar elliptic identity; it supplies neither prescribed singular-ray existence nor glancing propagation.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Flat regions and physical-time sign
targets.verified_scope: Flat regions and physical-time sign. RF31--RF32 compute the three regions and dr/dt=-rho/tau, distinguishing increasing physical time from increasing H-p parameter.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Exact singular Dirichlet difference
targets.proof_locator: In two dimensions the exact Dirichlet wave
targets.verified_scope: Exact singular Dirichlet difference. RF33--RF34 give Pu=0, zero actual Dirichlet value and two disjoint interior conormal branches with both signs and no cancellation for r>0.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Noncharacteristic N extension and normal trace
targets.proof_locator: They compress to the same boundary covectors
targets.verified_scope: Noncharacteristic N extension and normal trace. GE26 supplies the intrinsic N representative, whose actual jets agree with distributional limits; RF35 gives gamma1=2i delta-prime.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Exact base and compressed coordinate sections
targets.proof_locator: *The upper panel is the base projection
targets.verified_scope: Exact base and compressed coordinate sections. The two original SVG panels use tau=1, rho=plus/minus1 and zeta=plus/minus r; labels, directions and caption identify omitted coordinates and covector signs.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Flat coefficient counterexample belongs to N
targets.proof_locator: There is also a useful warning
targets.verified_scope: Flat coefficient counterexample belongs to the intrinsic N class by the full compressed tester estimate RFA3; every normal trace is zero.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Vanishing jets fail to detect compressed singularities
targets.verified_scope: Vanishing jets fail to detect compressed singularities. Interior conormals of a(r)delta(t) approach the boundary tangential covector; RF37 has a nonzero delta/delta-double-prime polynomial there, so the forcing hypothesis fails.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Mixed quadratic reflection without normalized coordinates
targets.verified_scope: Mixed quadratic reflection without normalized coordinates. Exercise1 and RF38--RF39 prove discriminant regions, both roots and the mixed reflection shift, invariant under lift changes and conormal rescaling.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Anisotropic wave and Schur complement
targets.verified_scope: Anisotropic wave and Schur complement. Exercise2 and RF40--RF41 prove positivity by an explicit vector, complete the principal square and derive the full normal reflection and physical velocities.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Elliptic Poisson singularity and exact boundary wavefront
targets.verified_scope: Elliptic Poisson singularity and exact boundary wavefront. Exercise3 and RF42 prove smoothness on strict strips, every distributional normal limit, extendibility with bounded Fourier growth, GE26 membership and the exact elliptic boundary wavefront identity.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

targets.title: Three strip reflections with the correct Hamilton parameter
targets.verified_scope: Three strip reflections with the correct Hamilton parameter. Exercise4 gives all three reflection times and covectors, the upper inward coordinate and explicit s=-t/2 reversal; the theorem applies to that Hamilton-oriented image and does not construct a prescribed-wavefront solution.
targets.disposition: Preserved, reviewed and bound to complete current programme proofs.

added_proof_nodes.proof_locator: The one-form calculation can also be verified directly
added_proof_nodes.scope: Full quadratic canonical pairing and its parameter derivative, giving the actual normal covector without invertibility of the entire principal form.

added_proof_nodes.proof_locator: For this second-order operator the absence
added_proof_nodes.scope: Full second-order Riccati identity, exact normal coefficient cancellation, both orderings and every symbolic and normal-parameter remainder.
Actual compressed quantization estimate for a flat coefficient times a tangential delta, with all ordinary derivatives, uniform normal endpoint and full residual realization.

added_proof_nodes.proof_locator: The common collar can be fixed
added_proof_nodes.scope: One common collar for every smoothing normal-jet error and finite source tester family through the complete EW argument.
Compact output sets, complete proper kernel errors, actual all-order global forcing norms and the Schwartz distributional uniqueness domain.
